intro: This document presents the comprehensive Land Cover / Land Use (LC/LU) nomenclature guidelines for the Copernicus local land monitoring product, Protected Areas 2021-2024. It meticulously defines the multi-level classification hierarchy, detailing each of the 59 LC/LU classes, their distinct geographic characteristics, and associated input datasets. Furthermore, the guidelines establish precise mapping rules, including minimum mapping unit (MMU) and minimum mapping width (MMW) criteria, alongside specific object delineation, overlap, and priority considerations. This technical framework ensures consistent and accurate interpretation for scientists, regulators, and data engineers engaged in monitoring Europe's protected areas.
keywords: Very High Resolution Earth Observation data
